title: Myanmar Climate Fact Sheet 2024
organization: Red Cross Red Crescent Climate Centre / Myanmar Red Cross Society
methodology: Synthesis of IPCC, World Bank, government and specialist evidence
limitations: Secondary synthesis; several component datasets predate 2024.

title: Myanmar's National Adaptation Programme of Action (NAPA) to Climate Change
geographic_coverage: National plus three PRA townships and seven physiographic regions
methodology: PRECIS 20×20 km, A2 scenario; seven stations; PRA/RRA and sector working groups
limitations: Legacy model/scenario; limited station representation; predates current conflict.

title: Nationally Determined Contributions
methodology: National policy framework and sectoral adaptation priorities
limitations: Policy intentions are not implementation evidence; institutional context changed sharply after 2021.

title: Nationally Determined Contributions Registry - Myanmar entry
methodology: UNFCCC registry of submitted NDCs
limitations: Confirms submission/status, not delivery or territorial applicability.

title: Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Myanmar
geographic_coverage: National with Dry Zone, Rakhine, Karenni and border examples
methodology: Triangulated conflict, humanitarian, livelihood and climate literature
limitations: Four-page synthesis; causal pathways often rest on secondary evidence.

title: Climate change as an arena of wartime political struggles: Greening of military rule and resistance in Myanmar
organization: Environment and Planning E: Nature and Space
methodology: Digital ethnography plus 15 interviews
limitations: Full text restricted in this verification session; abstract and data statement checked.

title: Myanmar September 2024 Typhoon Yagi Floods: Flood Extent Note
methodology: Satellite flood extent, exposure modelling, ground/report corroboration
limitations: Cannot cleanly separate Yagi from concurrent monsoon flooding; exposure ≠ damage.

title: Myanmar Emergency
methodology: WFP needs estimates and operational reporting
limitations: Operational reporting, not an impact evaluation.

title: Country - Myanmar Operational Data Portal
methodology: UN in Myanmar/UNHCR operational displacement estimates
limitations: Dynamic estimates; conflict/access constraints affect enumeration.

title: Cyclone Mocha: Aid efforts severely hampered by new restrictions
methodology: MSF field operations and staff observations
limitations: Organization-specific operational perspective; not nationally representative.

title: Mid-term Evaluation of Addressing Climate Change Risks on Water Resources and Food Security in the Dry Zone of Myanmar
methodology: Evaluation mission, project monitoring, field evidence and ratings
limitations: Pre-coup; project-specific; mid-term rather than terminal.

title: Terminal Evaluation: Addressing Climate Change Risks on Water and Food Security in the Dry Zone of Myanmar
methodology: UNDP independent evaluation record and management response metadata
limitations: Registry page verified; detailed terminal report findings not used here.

title: Myanmar's Enduring Polycrisis: Four Years into a Tumultuous Journey
geographic_coverage: National, examples including Rakhine and Chin
methodology: UNDP socioeconomic synthesis
limitations: Publication page verified; 12.4 MB full report was not retrievable in this browsing session, so only page claims are used.

title: Strengthening Food Security in Myanmar: A Roadmap for Localized Action
methodology: Food-security framework and policy/programme analysis
limitations: Recommendations are intended responses, not demonstrated outcomes; full PDF not parsed in session.

title: Supporting the People of Myanmar
methodology: Project portfolio and reported outputs through third-party implementers
limitations: Beneficiary/output reporting should not be read as evaluated effectiveness.

title: Layers of Deprivation: Multidimensional Poverty in Myanmar
temporal_coverage: People's Pulse Survey 2025; report issued October 2026; shock recall covers the preceding 12 months.
methodology: Nationwide phone survey of 7,463 households; adapted MPI and survey-weighted shock analysis.
limitations: Phone sampling under-represents remote, conflict-affected, stateless and displaced people; shock reports may overlap; associations are not causal.

title: Myanmar: Emergency and Resilience Plan, 2026–2028
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
geographic_coverage: 11 states and regions (not individually named in cited passages)
temporal_coverage: 2026–2028 plan; includes impacts of September 2024 floods and the March 2025 earthquake and describes ongoing FAO field presence.
methodology: FAO strategy drawing on food-security severity analysis, assessments, monitoring and existing field projects.
limitations: Strategic plan, not an independent evaluation; planned activities are commitments, and cited passages provide little named subnational outcome evidence.

title: Myanmar Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026
organization: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), Myanmar
temporal_coverage: 2026 humanitarian planning period; issued December 2025; draws on 2025 assessments and monitoring.
methodology: Inter-agency plan using multisource needs assessments, partner monitoring and an October 2025 access-severity exercise across 330 townships.
limitations: Planning forecasts are not impact evaluations; data and response reach are constrained by inaccessible areas and reliance on partner reporting.

title: Myanmar Health Cluster Bulletin: August 2026
organization: World Health Organization (WHO) / Myanmar Health Cluster
temporal_coverage: August 2026 disease and flood reporting; health-service figures cover January–June 2026.
methodology: Health Cluster partner reporting on outbreaks, flood impacts and service delivery; 49 partners submitted service data.
limitations: Reporting was incomplete or delayed; medicine and diagnostic shortages constrained response and partner data do not cover all activity.

title: Rakhine State, Western Myanmar: Flood Situation Update No. 1
organization: United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), Myanmar
temporal_coverage: Heavy-rain and flood impacts from early July 2026; partner information compiled through 17 July; report cover dated 20 July.
methodology: OCHA compilation of humanitarian-partner flood, damage, needs and response information at township, village and ward levels.
limitations: Affected-population and damage estimates required continued verification; road, communications and access constraints limited assessment and response.
